name: supplier-esg-portal
description: Bharat Carbon Supplier ESG portal — frontend (React) + backend (Express/MongoDB) + shared domain code

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run typecheck
